python3 - <<'PY'
import sys, random, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import cli, pyref
binary = cli.build()
rng = random.Random(7)

def fan(k, base_len, off=0):
    """k prefixes at length base_len with distinct 6-bit chunks under a common parent"""
    out = {}
    hi = rng.getrandbits(64) << 0
    hi = (hi >> (64 - 20)) << (64 - 20)   # fix top 20 bits
    for i in range(k):
        h, l = hi, rng.getrandbits(64)
        # place the varying chunk right after base_len
        ln = base_len
        # set bits [base_len, base_len+6) = i
        hh, ll = h, l
        hh, ll = pyref.set_bits(hh, ll, base_len - off, 6, i % 64)
        h, l = pyref.norm(hh, ll, ln + 1 if ln < 128 else ln)
        out[(h, l, min(128, ln + 1))] = rng.randint(0, 4194302)
    return out

cases = []
for k in (1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 20, 64):
    d = {}
    d.update(fan(k, 64))
    cases.append(('fan%d-64' % k, d))
for k in (7, 30, 64):
    d = {}
    d.update(fan(k, 16))
    d.update(fan(k, 60))
    cases.append(('fan%d-mixed' % k, d))
for name, d in cases:
    prefixes = sorted([(k[0], k[1], k[2], v) for k, v in d.items()])
    ops = [['put', '%016x%016x' % (k[0], k[1]), k[2], v] for k, v in d.items()]
    ops += [['save'], ['load_saved', 0]]
    addrs = ['%016x%016x' % (rng.getrandbits(64), rng.getrandbits(64)) for _ in range(5)]
    ops += [['image_query', addrs], ['query', addrs]]
    res = cli.results({'cases': [{'ops': ops}]}, binary)[0]
    snap = res['snapshots'][0]
    got = pyref.validate(snap)
    types = {}
    for (s, c, depth, origin, rhi, rlo, bmp) in pyref.LAST_NODES:
        w = int(snap['banks'][s][c // 2], 16)
        off = 128 if c % 2 else 0
        t = pyref.field(w, off, 3)
        types[t] = types.get(t, 0) + 1
    assert got == {(k[0], k[1], k[2]): v for k, v in d.items()}, name
    print('%-14s prefixes=%3d types=%s loads=%s' % (name, len(got), sorted(types.items()), res['loads']))
PY
